# Frozen scope-packet whitespace repair

Hosted docs job 111657740340 in run 37277442214 passes every documentation,
edition, inventory, constitutional and authoring check, then rejects four final
blank lines in the parent #315 scope packet. The staged Basis diff check did not
inspect that already committed parent. The actual whole-tree local failure and
complete decoded hosted log are retained here.

The four byte-frozen records receive the repository's existing exact-evidence
Git attributes. The original scope packet, hash manifest, criterion gate and
recorded observations remain unchanged. Maintained source and documentation do
not receive the exception. This is not a Rust/Lean behavior change, guarantee,
CI success claim or release approval. The repaired check covers the entire
committed tree, as the hosted check does.
